finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled and donor advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods. Uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods; pooled useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, and all residual intervals include zero. Raw base useful advantage is excluded under both methods; pooled is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling, and donor remains unresolved under both. All raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Sparse histories, overlapping human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed or rank ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
